text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today marks the end of a successful summer camp with Tokai Teio.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ouch, ouch, ouch… Since it's the last day, I figured I could go all out. But now my muscles are super sore.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Still, that just means I pushed myself to my limit, right?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Next up is the Japan Cup. I gotta surpass my current limits if I'm gonna win it.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'll show Prez and my fans just how much I've grown!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: …Oof, oof, oof. Ugh, and that was supposed to be such a cool speech, too!
